title: Broken Loop
text: The Choir's loop has broken twice this sol. The Cantor broadcasts one fragment, over and over: our own error code for a resource conflict.

choices.label: Pay for the disruption
choices.reply: We send replacement cells to the pylon. The loop resumes.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.reply: The fragment stops. The tenders stop too, and turn to face the colony.
